description: Explicit research-check groups. Finite check success does not assert an asymptotic theorem. Existing scripts retain their usual output behavior.

groups.name: short-path-fourier
groups.description: Exact algebra, geometric Hessian bounds, outward cap constants, and finite source normalizations for the charge interval, geometric action, product interpolation, retained three-crossing packet, local composition, and radical/midpoint cancellation. The uniform contour, geometric localization, and asymptotic proofs remain written.

groups.name: geometric-chain-contraction
groups.description: Outward bounds for the original power-three geometric neighbor map, exact covering and endpoint root certificates, and an independent replay. The continuation, contraction, and geometric identification are written proofs; no quantum source bound follows from these checks alone.

groups.name: directed-wire-packets
groups.description: Uniform parameter certificates for the actual complete cap and retained vertex, independent replay of the retained packet, and the first coupled attachment. The restricted Gaussian conclusion does not estimate the complementary full wire period.

groups.name: first-cap-complements
groups.description: Original cap bounds on exterior Fourier intervals and vertical connecting contours, their independent interval replays, and the retained-vertex envelope used in the comparison. The first-cap-central group contains the remaining first-attachment certificates.

groups.name: first-cap-central
groups.description: The first attachment's central angular and real-index complements, all index sides and cotangent aliases, independent interval replays, and the original Fourier-boundary corner error. Together with first-cap-complements these support the full original first-attachment proof, not arbitrary-chain closure.

groups.name: prepared-cap-domains
groups.description: Original larger-corner error, global retained-height bounds, the retained source bidisk, the analytic phase class, and all complementary estimates for the original prepared source on its specified complex disk. These checks support the written first-attachment theorem; they do not assert invariance of a full source class under arbitrary attachment.

groups.name: three-source-propagation
groups.description: Global real-period and joint complex-height kernel bounds, the wider actual input packet and cubic phase estimate, and all scalar/annulus budgets for source induction after the stated small-gradient entrance. The separate three-source-entrance group checks the actual next boundary sum; the remaining entrance implications are stated in the research proofs.

groups.name: three-source-entrance
groups.description: The original prepared source on a wider real interval, the next actual attachment, its enlarged real-output packet and full-period envelope, and the larger analytic phase class. Requires the existing prepared-cap-domains and three-source-propagation artifacts. Every finite-source and analytic scope is stated separately; this group does not assert arbitrary-chain closure or finitely many exceptional assignments.

groups.name: three-chain-source
groups.description: The full finite-source induction, its central and complementary contour comparisons, the exact chain assembly with marked partial-filling volume, and the inputs of the whole-boundary decay theorem. Requires the three-source-entrance artifacts. The contour, boundary-decay, and marked geometry arguments remain written proofs; these checks alone do not identify a knot invariant.

groups.name: mixed-crossing-interface
groups.description: Original three/four crossing sums, Fourier weights and geometric reference bounds. The coupled contours retain the central coefficient on ([0,.10] union [.22,.45] union [.5,1])^m, including every Fourier selection and arbitrary arrangements, uniformly through zero. Complete inner-sum asymptotics also hold on adjacent complex transition polygons and on the enlarged early selected cap. The older independent contours separately control [.22,1]^m; their estimates are not imported to the coupled transition. The remaining transition assemblies, open knot boundary conditions and arbitrary short partial fillings are unproved. Exact and outward checks accompany the written proofs. The earlier selected graph also retains the central coefficient on ([.10,.12] union [.22,.45])^m; its early blocks pay adjacent plateau height changes. Mixtures with the intervening transition remain separate.

groups.name: network-source-constants
groups.description: Exact scalar and matrix comparisons for the branching source theorem and the adjacent degree-power theorem. The full finite-trace, contour, and marked geometry arguments remain written proofs.

groups.name: short-corridor-algebra
groups.description: Exact marked rational-corridor threshold and modular-conjugacy calculations. These are presentation identities, not asymptotic or finite-level faithfulness tests.

groups.name: path-source-constants
groups.description: Exact comparisons and outward interval certificates for uniform pair composition, the full edge rectangle, and path geometry and complementary-angle bounds. The contour and source assembly proofs remain written.

groups.name: conway-certificates
groups.description: Exact interval certificates for the two-leaf and single-leaf inequalities used by the strict Conway proof.

groups.name: pointed-a
groups.description: Finite algebra and moving-parameter checks for the actual annihilator, pointed period and Gram ratio.

groups.name: phase-transfer
groups.description: Finite four-state and restricted-window identities for the general-plat phase estimates.

groups.name: local-foundations
groups.description: Recoupling of four representation factors, local tetrahedron volume and positive Conway variational checks.

groups.name: general-plat
groups.description: The original ordered set of local polynomial, normal, geometric, energy and Fourier checks for the general-plat route.

groups.name: moving-meridian-fillings
groups.description: Finite polynomial and root-grid crossing identities, including negative powers and both parities; exact rational Fourier comparisons for unequal signed twists. These checks do not replace the asymptotic proof.

groups.name: meridian-cusp
groups.description: Exact scalar composition and geometric meridian-frame identities for the preferred-cusp correction. These finite checks support the local calculations; they do not replace the topology or the asymptotic proof.

groups.name: trivalent-components
groups.description: Exact Newton quotient traces, old and additional cubic support, complete pairing, endpoint normalization and physical orientation types. The analytic component bound and filled-volume theorem have separate proofs.

groups.name: general-components
groups.description: Exact high-index Fourier coefficients, trace-difference cancellation and full Frobenius fusion at both level parities.

groups.name: curvature-fillings
groups.description: Exact edge-action and local gluing identities, finite complex-strip checks, and ordered bowtie-versus-octahedron comparisons for the curvature filling criterion. Finite check success does not replace the topology, analytic estimates, or geometric completion proof.

groups.name: local-tree-fillings
groups.description: Exact local analytic/geometric constants and finite full-index subtree contractions; scopes are stated in each output.

groups.name: geometric-characteristic
groups.description: Exact nonparabolic face maps, puncture transports, half-twist eigenlines and peripheral-ratio identities. The topology, boundary pairing and algebraic rigidity are proved in the manuscript. Requires SymPy.

groups.name: directed-tree-fillings
groups.description: Exact rational comparisons for the directed subtree criterion, its degree-independent twist bound and a short-center star; no asymptotic inference from samples.

groups.name: strict-tree-geometry
groups.description: Exact local white-map, disk-longitude, cubic-response and fold identities for inserting and filling a zero-power crossing circle at an unmarked product junction.

groups.name: balanced-terminal-fans
groups.description: Exact fan recurrence, rational balance margin, oriented stellar subdivision, face parity and endpoint pairings. Analytic estimates and metric completion are proved in the manuscript.

groups.name: filling-supremum
groups.description: Exact Chebyshev residues, finite derivative interpolation, and original signed crossing matrices for the level-uniform filling bound. The norm inequalities are proved in the text.

groups.name: source-cancellation
groups.description: Original rational source certificate, both-parity cap identities and exact shared-load rounding. The asymptotic and cancellation conclusions are written proofs, not finite-level extrapolations.

groups.name: singleton-envelope
groups.description: Exact rational obstruction to a shared-weight envelope for one nonzero sector; oriented sphere, matching and knot parity. This is not a bound for the knot invariant.

groups.name: cyclic-source-constants
groups.description: Rational interval certificates for the fixed inequalities in the alternating-generator three-braid proof. This does not sample diagram sizes or prove a volume limit by computation.

groups.name: mixed-boundary-memory
groups.description: Focused checks for the exact finite boundary potential, exponential incoming-memory bound, seam source allocation, fixed closure obstruction, all-row half-angle refinement, height-dependent source profiles, and finite attenuation reduction. Outputs go to temporary files; canonical source records remain unchanged. Written path and convexity arguments and unresolved interface signs are not certified by this runner.

groups.name: mixed-seam-connectors
groups.description: Reevaluate the complete half-angle reference-window reserve and all 64 real connector corner inequalities using saved covers and root centers. The continuity and arbitrary-length independent-seam assembly are written proofs. General neighboring angles, adjacent seams and whole-period noncancellation remain outside these checks. Canonical records are not overwritten.

groups.name: mixed-closed-half
groups.description: Exact gradient identities, saved original-log run comparisons, rational general-angle seam bounds and the closed-half-period assembly checks. Source profiles and original finite factors are retained. These checks support the written closed-half proof; they do not establish a whole-period asymptotic or arbitrary short-filling stability. Outputs use temporary files.

groups.name: mixed-right-interface
groups.description: Focused scalar and exact checks for complete-row reduction, its interior bracket and derivative endpoints, two-right-neighbor transport, selected-height removal and coherent/raw clamping at every upper-transition incidence, global nonlow upper removal, long-run boundary costs including zero contacts, retained incoming-edge bounds, low transport, the combined low/early/plateau/right region, local Q source extensions, sharper four-before-four heights, and a cubic collision with its marked lift. Continuous maximization, concavity, allocation and continuation remain written proofs. These supporting deductions are used alongside the completed mixed-full-cyclic assembly; they do not separately supply open-boundary or arbitrary short-filling estimates. Saved records are not overwritten.

groups.name: mixed-full-cyclic
groups.description: Saved 384-bit local derivative replays for the complete immediate-right and active/frozen distance-two families, followed by exact nonlow-middle, seam raw-exterior and complete cyclic-trace assembly checks. The written proof retains all original source rows, selections, parities, scalar and Gaussian coefficient. No open-tangle or arbitrary short partial-filling theorem is asserted. Outputs use temporary files.

groups.name: mixed-open-word-local
groups.description: Saved checks of the all-length ordinary-endpoint Hessian bound, four endpoint critical maps and separate one-vertex disks, the complete endpoint packet on both the private-index and enlarged outer-cap rectangles, and exact extraction of the narrower endpoint images. Critical geometry and endpoint source coverage do not assert a global open-word contour estimate, nonzero whole contraction or arbitrary short-filling stability. Outputs use temporary files.

groups.name: mixed-first-cap
groups.description: Saved checks of the original three/four endpoint sums: correlated real-cut gaps, complete real-row tails, and both horizontal Fourier contributions. These prove a nonzero cap asymptotic near the actual outgoing critical images, retaining every private row. They do not control the remaining whole open-word contraction. Outputs use temporary files.

groups.name: mixed-two-cap-transport
groups.description: Exact two-cap composition and the inhomogeneous difference equation of its finite Gram polynomial. The saved original two-four critical point certifies an obstruction to the separate regular-phase estimate. These checks neither refute the full source nor prove its noncancellation. Outputs use temporary files.

groups.name: mixed-terminal-source
groups.description: Saved outward checks for the last conditional kernel on all four ordinary endpoint graphs. Complete circle coverage, every revived row and both Fourier contributions give a nonzero local packet. The remaining open-word contour is not certified. Outputs use temporary files.

groups.name: mixed-open-local-source
groups.description: Complete source on the reduced universal disks and exact assembly of the nonzero local Gaussian for every fixed open three/four word. Includes both conditional orientations and original endpoint normalization. The rest of the contour and selected Fourier terms remain unproved. Outputs use temporary files.

groups.name: mixed-geometric-calibration
groups.description: Saved exact branch and action identities, the unchanged source-witness pair-sum extraction, and the algebra for geometric/source critical-point identification. Written continuation and Hessian proofs remain essential. No full open-source dominance or finite-exception conclusion. Outputs use temporary files.

groups.name: mixed-open-endpoint-estimates
groups.description: Saved endpoint and transport inputs, complete ordinary left-cut comparisons for both own types, and fixed obstructions to overly large auxiliary domains. Complex extension, typed last-row envelopes, the optimized half-row acceptance method and buffer arguments are written deductions. The uniform half/last-row comparisons, full open-source theorem and finite-exception conclusion remain open. Outputs use temporary files.
